name: Attack the enemy ships
text:
ATTACK
Select your ship and right-click on an enemy unit to attack. You can also initiate an attack by pressing the Attack button in the Command Panel or by using [ |-2-| ].
Hold [ |-1-| ] and drag the mouse to target multiple units at once.
MOVE ATTACK
Select your ship and press the Move Attack button in the Command Panel, or [ |-3-| ], to command it to move toward a position while attacking any enemies along the way.
Ships behave in battle according to their assigned tactics and stances, which can be configured in the Tactics Panel.
TACTICS
Passive - The unit does not react to enemies at all.
Defensive - The unit only reacts if it is attacked.
Aggressive - The unit engages enemies within its intervention range or if allies are attacked nearby.
Hunter - The unit actively seeks and attacks any visible enemy on the map.
ATTACK STYLES
Flyby - The unit performs repeated dive attacks, creating disruption and constant movement.
Hold - The unit maintains its current position while attacking.
Chase - The unit moves toward the target until it reaches firing range.
Orbit - The unit circles around the enemy while attacking.
Attacks can also be executed in formations, allowing for more coordinated and strategic strikes.

name: Build Modules and Ships
text:
BUILD MODULES 
Open the Modules Panel, select the desired modules, and attach them to the Command Center, [ |-1-| ] to rotate. 
The Command Center expand by building structural modules, utility modules, facilities, and weapons.
BUILD SHIPS 
Open the Ships Panel, select the facility from the top of the menu, if already built, or the Command Center, and choose the unit to produce. 
Ship types include fighters, mechguns, warships, and utilities. The Command Center build utility ships. Fighters and corvettes require Light Facilities, warships need Heavy Facilities.

name: Camera Controls
text:
DIRECTIONAL COMMANDS 
Move the camera left and right [ A ] [ D ]
Move the camera forward and backward [ W ] [ S ]

Move the camera up and down [ E ] [ Q ]
You can also move the camera by moving the mouse cursor to the screen edges, if option is enabled.
Hold [ |-1-| ] to set the arrival orientation, if needed.

FOCUS
Select an item/unit and press [ |-1-| ] to focus on it.
Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.

name: Max Crew Capacity reached
text:
CREW FULL
Build additional Crew Quarters (Modules Panel) to increase max crew capacity.
Make sure the Crew Quarters you've queued are actually under construction, check the build queues, and prioritize them if needed.
The Crew button (Parameters panel) opens the detailed window (usage/capacity overview).

name: Energy exhausted
text:
ENERGY CRISIS
If systems consume more energy than is produced, build additional generators (Modules Panel).
-Solar Panels: low output and storage.
-Nuclear Generators: high output and storage.
-Quantum Generators: very high output, no storage.
-Power Accumulator: no output, very high storage.
Generators placed close together gain a production boost.
Overloaded generators take damage and may explode, causing area damage.

Module energy usage is displayed in the Selection Panel (bottom-right) when selected; systems drawing energy can be disabled through the Command Panel.
The Energy button (Parameters panel) opens the detailed window (income/outcome overview).

name: Collecting Resources
text:
Resources are needed to build the base, create units, and unlock technologies.
HARVEST 
Select Scavengers and right-click on asteroids to collect resources from them, or by pressing the Harvest button in the Command Panel, or [ |-1-| ]. 
Each asteroid type has its own yield and extraction speed.

SALVAGE 
Select Scavengers and right-click on wrecks to salvage them or by using the Salvage button in the Command Panel, or [ |-2-| ].
Wrecks appear near derelicts or when ships are destroyed, they contain resources and technologies.
REFINING 
Resources are returned to base for refining. Build Drop Points to speed it up.

name: Movement and Navigation
text:
Ships move across the map using propulsion or hyperspace.
NAVIGATION  
Select a unit, right-click to open the movement interface, or by pressing the Move button in the Command Panel, or [ |-3-| ].
To move vertically, hold left-click and drag the mouse.
Hold [ |-1-| ] and drag the mouse to set the arrival orientation.

TACTICAL VIEW 
Press [ |-2-| ] to open the Tactical View, where all game overlays are enabled.

name: Research new technologies
text:
RESEARCH
Open the Modules Panel, select the Research Center (under the Utility tab), and attach it to the Command Center.
Once the Research Center is built, you can start researching available technologies from the Research Panel.
Research is structured around Tech Eras, so you’ll need to reach a certain research level to unlock the next Tech Era. Click on Tech Era in the Parameters Panel to view details.
TECHNOLOGY TREE 
The Technology Tree displays all available research paths. Here you can see the prerequisites needed to unlock the technologies you want to obtain.

name: Resources exhausted
text:
RESOURCE CRISIS
Balance harvesting, wreck salvaging, and refining. Build additional Scavengers (Ships Panel) or Drop Points (Modules Panel), if needed.
Pause or slow down production queues for modules and ships.
Salvage nearby wrecks for quick resources, assigned Scavengers will automatically keep the area clean.
The Idle button in the Selection Panel selects inactive collectors.
Command Center can enable Auto-Harvest (Command Panel): all collectors in range will automatically gather resources from nearby asteroids.
The Resource button (Parameters panel) opens the detailed window (income/outcome overview).

name: Max Resource Capacity reached
text:
RESOURCE FULL
Build additional Resource Warehouses (Modules Panel) to increase max storage capacity.
Enable Auto-Containers in the Deck Panel to auto-build and dock containers when storage is full. These can be recycled later.
To offload resources, increase production queues or boost production speed.

name: New Tech Era available
text:
TECH ERA
Technological progress is represented by a level (Parameters Panel) and advances through Tech Eras:
Era 1 - Start
Era 2 - Level 100
Era 3 - Level 250
Era 4 - Level 500
Era 5 - Level 1000
Once a research threshold is reached, you can unlock the next Tech Era.
To do so, open the Research Panel and, under the Utility section, start the corresponding research.
Advancing to a new era consumes a significant amount of energy, but no resources.
The Tech Era button (Parameters panel) opens the detailed window.

name: Unit Interface
text:
MODULES PANEL (left) Contains the list of modules that can be built along with the available research technologies. Both are organized into categories.
PARAMETERS PANEL (top) Displays the main game parameters: resources, crew, energy, and the current technological era.
SHIPS PANEL (right) Contains the types of ships that can be built, such as fighters, mechguns, warships, and utility ships. This panel also provides access to the docking bays of the Command Center and Facilities.
SELECTION PANEL (bottom) Shows the current selection and its related statistics. It can display a single unit or multiple selections. This section also provides access to quick selection buttons, such as fleet, visible and armed ships.
TACTICS PANEL (bottom-left) Contains all unit behaviors, stances and formations available to selected units.
COMMANDS PANEL (bottom-right) Contains all commands that can be assigned to selected units.
